_comment: Golden coordinates for the Shikoku elevation database (plan §36). Expected values are baselined from the 2026-08-18 build (DEM5 merge + DEM10 fallback, 1m int16). Points are chosen on stable/gentle terrain (city plains, verified inland areas, one DEM10 fallback area) where a 5m/10m DEM is reliable; sharp mountain peaks are intentionally excluded because their value is highly coordinate-sensitive. Tolerance: 10m for DEM5, 20m for DEM10.
